title: Create a GitHub gist from your logged-in session
task: Publish a file as a public or secret gist without a personal access token.

steps.note: Opens the gist editor in the signed-in profile.
Find the description, filename and content fields by their @e refs.
The content box is CodeMirror, so fill() on the textarea does not stick; set it through the CodeMirror instance.
The create button is a split button: the arrow opens the public/secret choice. Pick it, then click create.

caveats: Content is a CodeMirror editor: use the instance's setValue, not fill().
The create control is a split button; choose public vs secret from its menu before clicking.
GitHub changes this page now and then. If a step breaks, open a PR with the new selector and bump verified_on.
author: jeet-dhandha
